soundness_flags.label: ass:randomization
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited Wang assumption randomizes treatment relative to T(a) only, whereas this condition additionally assumes conditional independence from both potential censoring times; either justify and retag this stronger full-potential-outcome design condition or weaken it and rework the completion argument.

soundness_flags.label: ass:vc-leaves and oeq:uniform-changing-contact-inference
soundness_flags.one_line: The bound uses an undeclared V in VC(G)≤V and in the endpoint rate, while the declared symbol is Vc; use one symbol consistently.

soundness_flags.label: prop:selection-projection
soundness_flags.one_line: Conditional outer-set containment implies projected interval containment by direct infimum/supremum monotonicity, so this root proposition has no substantive mathematical content and should be a corollary of a nontrivial whole-set coverage theorem, not a solve target.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited source states consistency, overlap, T(a) ⟂ A | X, and censoring overlap; it does not state A ⟂ (T(0),T(1),C(0),C(1)) | X.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the selection-projection proposition with a one-line corollary and make the actual joint whole-set/VC-leaf coverage construction the nontrivial target.

Repair the randomization assumption: either give a clinical/design justification for randomization of both potential censoring processes and mark it novel, or prove that the completion only needs Wang’s stated T(a) randomization condition.
Replace every V in the VC assumption and inference rate with the declared Vc, then state a concrete admissible h_n schedule relative to rho_n and beta.

recommended_next_step: Revise the assumption basis and remove the vacuous projection target, then advance the surviving field-grade sharp-set and changing-contact inference kernel to Stage 0.
